stories.title: P6 — the Feature Builder UI (PRD §13.2#7): a React+DRF UI surface over the §6.5 one-click labeled export that ALREADY EXISTS from US-31 (only the UI is missing) — trigger an export off the celery container, surface its MANIFEST/result; NOT P8-gated

acceptance_criteria.text: A DRF endpoint + React view triggers the EXISTING §6.5 one-click labeled export (US-31) — NO new export math; the UI invokes the existing export Celery task, which runs OFF the celery container (NEVER web/gunicorn, #289) and re-derives from raw via the shared US-30 extractor (Principle #2; raw=immutable, §6.4.1). The export parameters (destination, dataset id) are config-driven (Principle #1). Verified by a pytest/AST test that the view delegates to the existing US-31 export task (not a re-implemented export) and that triggering it is a Celery task dispatch, not a web-view-side export.

The UI surfaces the export RESULT — the produced labeled dataset + its US-36-pattern MANIFEST (dataset id, content hash, LC_ALL=C sort, SHA-256 of decompressed bytes) and a run/status indicator — read back deterministically from the existing export output. Verified by a pytest test that, over a banked export fixture, the view reports the MANIFEST + content hash matching the produced dataset, deterministically (run-twice identical), OFFLINE (zero firehose).

The Feature Builder view renders the trigger control + result/MANIFEST surface in the US-48 React frontend (built fresh per §14). No silent state change: triggering an export NEVER flips scoring_enabled/trading_enabled (US-11 guard green over this path) and the export is idempotent. The Feature Builder tests are wired into the canonical ci.yml 'test' job via an ImportError trap on the named endpoint/task function (H1) so a deleted/renamed surface fails pytest collection. New backend AND frontend files carry metadata front matter. Deployed + smoke-tested on the VPS.

forward_plan.note: NOT committed to sprint-11 scope, to avoid the over-commitment the retrospectives repeatedly warn against on heavy phases. Sprint-11 CLOSES the P6 dashboard VPS deploy gap (J1/J2/J4 → the dashboard chain DoD-done, J3) and adds the two NON-P8-gated dashboard views (Config/model control skin, Feature Builder UI). The operator-driven endgame acts (I2 soak, I3 promote) and the P8-DEPENDENT dashboard views stay deferred. After sprint-11, all THREE PRD pillars are delivered AND DoD-done at the dashboard layer; the remaining project DoD is the operator-driven soak/endgame plus the P8 trading-execution path (the 'trades the winners' pillar's execution half). MANDATORY NEXT EPIC (operator-committed, NOT optional): the Copy-Trade Dashboard v1 (solanatrilly_copytrade_SPEC.md, operator-provided 2026-06-17) — PLAN IT AS THE NEXT EPIC (sprint-12) once sprint-11 closes. It is a first-class trading pipeline SIBLING to the prediction pipeline (same buy/sell execution path, same paper(observe)↔live toggle with observe as the safety-gated default, same config-driven control + click-to-download export) but driven by a JSON list of ~10 wallets instead of a model. Non-negotiables from the SPEC: a SEPARATE copytrade_engine service/worker with its OWN Helius subscription (subscribes to WALLETS not the token firehose), OWN copytrade.* config namespace, OWN copytrade_-prefixed DB tables (§5 isolation — must NOT share mutable state with the firehose/model pipeline); copy a watched wallet ONLY when it BUYS a pump.fun token still on the bonding curve (PRE-graduation), first-buy-only + dedupe-token-across-wallets, NEVER mirror their sells (we exit on OUR TP/SL/curve-completion/max-hold rules; tight SL deliberate); a new 'Copy Trade' dashboard tab (JSON upload, ON/OFF, Observe/Live, SOL size + TP%/SL% overrides, the key per-wallet PnL table); FRESH-START on every upload (a new cohort JSON wipes the old cohort entirely — close/settle open positions, purge old copytrade_* records; exactly one active cohort, no cross-cohort history in v1); Observe(paper) is the DEFAULT and the safety gate (live trading NOT enabled until the operator flips it after the observe soak). Honor the §1 NON-goals (no per-wallet manual controls, no candle charts, no history) — do not add scope. This SPEC is committed scope: the project is NOT complete until it is built.
items: NEXT EPIC (sprint-12, MANDATORY operator-committed scope) — Copy-Trade Dashboard v1 per solanatrilly_copytrade_SPEC.md: a SEPARATE copytrade_engine worker with its own Helius wallet-subscription + own copytrade.* config namespace + own copytrade_-prefixed tables (cohort/wallets/positions/pnl_by_wallet), §5-isolated from the firehose/model pipeline; copy a watched wallet's FIRST pump.fun PRE-graduation curve buy only (dedupe-token-across-wallets, never mirror sells), exit on OUR config-driven TP/SL/curve-completion/max-hold; a new 'Copy Trade' tab (JSON upload + §6 fresh-start wipe, ON/OFF, Observe(default)/Live, SOL size + TP/SL overrides, per-wallet PnL table); reuses the existing buy/sell execution path + the §6.5 click-to-download export (include copytrade_positions). I2 — the operator-driven P7-3 SOAK before promotion (oracle §6; MODEL_HANDOFF caveats): a head-to-head OBSERVE soak (v3.2 vs the incumbent, ~30/day — NOT shallower: v3.2 is depth-fragile and INVERTS at ~10/day; the mean/$ lift is directional-only P=86%, only the median lift is significant and does not survive Bonferroni). Watch for live inversion (every prior champion inverted with real money). OPERATOR-DRIVEN — NOT a sprint story; spends firehose budget deliberately — plan the activation ledger (ops/firehose_activation_log.md) BEFORE it starts. US-46 (sprint-10) confirmed the scorer VPS-live so this is UNBLOCKED.

I3 — the ENDGAME: when the soak HOLDS, the operator promotes trilly_pregrad_v3_2 via the US-42 promote_blend() + starts the firehose to make live predictions. THAT IS THE WHOLE-PROJECT DEFINITION OF DONE. OPERATOR-DRIVEN — NOT a sprint story. No capital before the soak holds (MODEL_HANDOFF: SOAK CANDIDATE only).

P8 trading-execution path (PRD §10, the execution half of the 'trades the winners' pillar): PumpSwap buy/sell behind trading_enabled (port reference chainstacklabs manual_buy_pumpswap.py / manual_sell_pumpswap.py; the PumpSwap IDL pump_amm.json for account order) + the tape settler + the replay harness/gate. Live Positions board (PRD §13.2#1, the operator's #1 ask): one card per open position with entry/peak/current markers, every armed exit threshold drawn + a countdown to the next to fire, live PnL, time-in-trade, opening score. DEFERRED — depends on P8 position rows (the trading/exit engine producing open positions); nothing to render until P8.

Calibration & PnL analytics (PRD §13.2#4): win-rate by score band, realized PnL by exit trigger, score-vs-actual scatter, calibration curve. DEFERRED — needs REALIZED PnL from P8; without executed positions and outcomes there is no PnL to calibrate against. (The view that would have made the t2 inversion obvious in seconds — worth building the moment P8 produces outcomes.)
